dominio: Using coding agents for application development (~17%)

preguntas.pregunta: Your security team requires that the coding agent must NEVER read files under ./secrets/ or run 'terraform destroy', regardless of what the model decides. Which mechanism provides this guarantee?

opciones.A: A PostToolUse hook that logs the command.
opciones.B: Permission deny rules plus a PreToolUse hook that blocks the matching tool calls.
opciones.C: A skill describing safe infrastructure procedures.
opciones.D: A rule/memory file (e.g. AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md) stating the policy.

preguntas.explicacion: 'Nunca / garantizar' → control determinista: reglas deny de permisos y hook PreToolUse (se ejecuta ANTES de la herramienta y puede bloquear). Las reglas/memoria son orientativas; PostToolUse corre cuando la acción ya ocurrió.

preguntas.pregunta: Developers repeatedly ask the coding agent to 'deploy the service to Cloud Run' and the agent performs the 8-step procedure inconsistently. You want a reusable, versioned procedure with helper scripts that is only loaded into context when relevant. What should you create?

opciones.A: A skill (folder with SKILL.md, name/description frontmatter and optional scripts).
opciones.B: An always-on rule containing the full procedure.

preguntas.explicacion: Procedimiento repetible con scripts + carga bajo demanda (progressive disclosure: solo nombre/descripción hasta que aplica) → skill. Una regla siempre activa consume contexto en cada turno.

preguntas.pregunta: You want a 'security reviewer' that analyzes diffs in a clean context window, can only read and search files (no edits, no shell), and runs in parallel with the main agent. What should you configure?

opciones.A: An MCP server exposing a 'review' tool.
opciones.D: A subagent definition with a restricted tool allowlist (e.g. Read, Grep, Glob).

preguntas.explicacion: Contexto aislado + herramientas de mínimo privilegio + trabajo en paralelo → subagente con allowlist de herramientas.

preguntas.pregunta: The coding agent must query live BigQuery table schemas and recent Cloud Logging errors while writing code. Which primitive fits best?

opciones.B: An MCP server (e.g. Google-managed remote MCP servers for BigQuery/Logging) configured for the agent.
opciones.C: A skill with a static copy of the schemas.

preguntas.explicacion: Datos vivos / acciones sobre sistemas externos → servidor MCP. Copias estáticas se desactualizan.

preguntas.pregunta: A developer configured an MCP server for a Google Cloud API by pasting a long-lived service account key into the project's MCP config file, which is committed to Git. What is the recommended fix?

opciones.C: Remove the key and authenticate with Application Default Credentials (the developer's identity or Workload Identity Federation), granting least-privilege roles; reference any unavoidable secrets through environment variables or Secret Manager, never inline.
opciones.D: Move the key to a .env file in the same repository.

preguntas.explicacion: Nada de llaves de larga vida en archivos versionados. ADC (sin secreto almacenado) con roles mínimos; si hace falta un secreto, variable de entorno o Secret Manager.

preguntas.pregunta: A company wants its developers to use Claude Code billed and governed through its Google Cloud project, without distributing Anthropic API keys. What configuration is needed?

opciones.A: Set CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID and CLOUD_ML_REGION, authenticate with Google Application Default Credentials, and grant developers roles/aiplatform.user.
opciones.B: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to a key stored in Secret Manager.
opciones.C: Deploy Claude Code on Cloud Run.

preguntas.explicacion: Claude Code usa los modelos de Claude en la plataforma de Google Cloud (Vertex AI / Agent Platform) con CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1 + proyecto + región, autenticando con ADC e IAM (roles/aiplatform.user). Sin API keys de Anthropic.

preguntas.pregunta: 300 developers use Claude Code on Google Cloud. Finance reports unpredictable costs because different developers use different model versions, and behavior changed when an alias moved to a newer model. What should you do?

opciones.A: Pin specific model versions via environment variables (e.g. ANTHROPIC_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL) in centrally managed settings.
opciones.B: Ask developers to choose the cheapest model.
opciones.D: Switch every developer to a different region.

preguntas.explicacion: Fijar versiones concretas de modelo en configuración gestionada centralmente da costo y comportamiento predecibles; los alias pueden cambiar de destino.

preguntas.pregunta: You want the coding agent to be unable to finish its task until the unit tests pass. Which configuration achieves this most reliably?

opciones.A: A rule saying 'always run tests before finishing'.
opciones.C: A PreToolUse hook on the Edit tool.
opciones.D: A Stop hook that runs the tests and, if they fail, blocks the stop and returns the failure output so the agent continues working.

preguntas.explicacion: El hook Stop se ejecuta cuando el agente intenta terminar; puede bloquear y devolver el motivo (tests fallidos) para que continúe. Es un 'definition of done' determinista.

preguntas.pregunta: You built a set of skills, hooks, subagents and MCP server configs that 200 developers across 30 repositories must install consistently and update centrally. What is the best way to distribute them?

opciones.B: Register each skill in Agent Registry for IDE agents.
opciones.C: Copy the files into every repository by hand.
opciones.D: Package them as a plugin (from an internal marketplace) and enforce baseline policies with organization-managed settings.

preguntas.explicacion: Un plugin empaqueta rules/skills/hooks/subagentes/MCP como una unidad versionada; la configuración gestionada por la organización impone los mínimos. Los registros de la plataforma gobiernan agentes en runtime, no la personalización del IDE.

preguntas.pregunta: Your product lets an agent execute LLM-generated Python for thousands of users concurrently. You need kernel-level isolation between sessions and sub-second startup. What should you use?

opciones.A: Run the code inside the agent's own process with exec().
opciones.B: A Compute Engine VM per request.
opciones.C: Cloud Run with the default compute service account.
opciones.D: GKE Agent Sandbox (gVisor runtime) with warm pools, no service account token mounted, non-root, resource limits and restricted egress.

preguntas.explicacion: Código no confiable a escala + aislamiento de kernel + arranque sub-segundo → Agent Sandbox en GKE (gVisor + warm pool). C no aísla a nivel kernel y la SA por defecto está sobreprivilegiada; B es lento y costoso.

preguntas.pregunta: Which TWO settings are essential in the pod spec that runs untrusted agent-generated code on GKE? (Choose 2)
preguntas.explicacion: gVisor aporta el kernel en espacio de usuario; no montar el token de la service account evita que el código robe credenciales. hostNetwork y privileged rompen el aislamiento; ':latest' no es reproducible.

preguntas.pregunta: A regulated bank requires that source code never leaves its Google Cloud perimeter, while developers use AI coding agents daily. Which development environment design fits?

opciones.A: Cloud Workstations in a private configuration inside a VPC Service Controls perimeter, with no public IPs and controlled egress (e.g. Secure Web Proxy allowlist).
opciones.D: Developers' personal laptops with the agent's local sandbox.

preguntas.explicacion: 'El código no sale del perímetro' → Cloud Workstations privadas + VPC-SC + sin IP pública + egress controlado.

preguntas.pregunta: A team uses a coding agent to write an ADK agent (inner loop). They want a repeatable path to scaffold, evaluate, deploy to Agent Runtime and publish to Gemini Enterprise without hand-written glue scripts. What should they adopt?

opciones.A: The Agents CLI lifecycle (create/scaffold → eval → deploy to agent runtime/Cloud Run/GKE → publish), invoked by the coding agent and by CI/CD non-interactively.
opciones.C: A single bash script that runs pip install.
opciones.D: Manual console clicks documented in a wiki.

preguntas.explicacion: El outer loop estandarizado (Agents CLI / adk deploy) conecta el código con evaluación, despliegue y publicación de forma repetible y automatizable en CI.

preguntas.pregunta: You run the coding agent headless in CI to fix lint errors. The pipeline hangs waiting for permission prompts. What is the safest fix?

opciones.A: Give the CI service account Owner.
opciones.B: Run with the flag that skips all permission checks.
opciones.D: Pre-approve only the specific commands/tools needed (e.g. allow 'npm run lint' and file edits in src/) in the CI settings, keep deny rules, and run inside an isolated, least-privilege runner.

preguntas.explicacion: Allowlist mínima de comandos + deny rules + runner aislado. Saltarse todos los permisos elimina las barreras de seguridad.

preguntas.pregunta: The agent keeps using the wrong test framework in a monorepo where only the /payments service uses pytest-asyncio. How should you provide this guidance efficiently?

opciones.A: Add it to a global always-on rule for every repository.
opciones.B: Create a PreToolUse hook that rejects all test runs.
opciones.D: Add a scoped rule/memory file for that directory (or a path/glob-scoped rule) so it only loads when working in /payments.

preguntas.explicacion: Convenciones = reglas/memoria. Mejor acotadas por ruta/glob para no gastar contexto en todo el repo.

preguntas.pregunta: A coding agent with shell access might be tricked by a malicious README (prompt injection) into sending code to an external host. Which combination best reduces this risk? (Choose 2)

opciones.B: Tell the model in the rules to ignore instructions in files.
opciones.C: Require approval for, or deny, network commands such as curl/wget and untrusted MCP tools.
opciones.D: Restrict network egress to an allowlist of hosts (sandbox network policy / proxy).

preguntas.explicacion: Defensa en profundidad determinista: egress restringido + deny/ask en comandos de red. Las instrucciones al modelo no son un control de seguridad.
